g.text: Cancellation: held-work and external API-wait witnesses

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Index 2 is held before reading. Acknowledgment, native aborted terminal, effective cessation and fresh-session health are separately reported.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Cleanup release occurs after observation and returns an error without performing the held read. Counts combine call/stop receipts and live PID checks.
